name: Beastwang
line: Independent dance music culture, built from the ground up.
body: Beastwang is a Leicester-born underground dance music brand founded by Nico Singh in 2012.

What began as an independent club night grew into one of Leicester’s most recognisable rave brands, building a loyal community around bass music, UK garage, jungle, drum and bass, grime, house and wider underground club culture.

Across more than a decade, Beastwang has delivered everything from intimate sweatbox parties to large-scale multi-room events, working across clubs, warehouses, alternative venues and indoor festival-style productions. The brand has hosted national and international artists, supported emerging local talent, and helped shape a new generation of Leicester ravers.
alt: Crowd at a Beastwang dance music event.

name: Doppler
line: A home for underground music, radio and creative community.
body: Doppler Studio & Radio is an independent underground music venue, online radio station and creative space based in Leicester.

Built around community, music and DIY culture, Doppler was created as a home for underground artists, DJs, promoters, broadcasters and audiences who needed a space outside of traditional nightlife structures.

The project brings several moving parts under one roof: a live events venue, a radio platform, a recording and content space, and a community-led cultural hub. It exists as both a physical space and a wider platform for people creating, sharing and experiencing underground music.
alt: DJs and audience at Doppler Studio.

name: At One
line: House, techno and disco with a considered club experience.
body: At One was a Leicester-based house and electronic music event brand built around high-quality line-ups, strong production and a more refined club experience.

The project brought established names from across house, disco, techno and electronic music to the city, with previous headliners including Artwork, Crazy P, Dusky, Horse Meat Disco, Kettama, Mall Grab, Mella Dee, Paul Woolford and Ross From Friends.

At One required a different approach to audience, tone and presentation. While rooted in dance music, the brand spoke to a more house-focused, style-conscious and experience-led crowd. This meant the creative direction, copy, visual identity, customer journey and promotional networks had to feel more considered, polished and intentional.
alt: Colourful balloons above the At One dancefloor.

name: Wang Records
line: An independent label taking UK club culture beyond the dancefloor.
body: Wang Records is an independent UK dance music label born as a spin-off from Beastwang.

The label was created to take the energy, music knowledge and community built through Beastwang and contribute to the dance music scene in a different way. Where Beastwang existed through live events, Wang Records gave the brand a recorded output: a platform for new artists, new sounds and underground club music with a clear visual and cultural identity.

The label has played a role in pushing a new wave of UK club music after the modern bassline era, supporting artists working across alternative bass, UK garage, breaks, bass-heavy house and forward-thinking underground sounds. Its releases have reached clubs, festivals and radio shows across the world, with support from respected names including Annie Mac, DJ EZ, The Blessed Madonna and more.
alt: Stelahr record artwork from Wang Records.

name: Audrey
line: From an ambitious idea to a distinctive hospitality experience.
body: Negotiating leases, overseeing contracts, budgeting, sourcing quality tradesman at short notice, planning the timescale of the build and committing to early mornings and late nights for the next three months.

Finding resilience within yourself, motivating the team of the build, being absent from your personal life, monitoring cash-flow, constant runs to DIY shops, recruiting Leicester’s best bar manager, daring to go all the way pink, setting up with all your suppliers, liaising with the design agency and starting to reel out teasers.

Building an identity to be sustainable, recognisable and one that your potential customers can align with. The brand was built for the potential of opening up further bars in different cities. It pays off to use an agency that understands commercial branding to have a professional and clean aesthetic.

name: Sophy
line: A cocktail bar shaped through mood, music and memorable design.
body: Sophy was our first cocktail bar build and an important step into hospitality, interior-led venue design and customer experience.

The project involved taking a renowned local property and giving it the attention, care and creative direction it needed to become a highly sought-after bar. We were originally brought into the project for design and marketing support, but the process developed into something broader, giving us hands-on experience across the build process, interior decisions, venue positioning and the detail required to bring a physical hospitality concept to life.

The aim was to create a bar that felt fun, moody and memorable. Sophy needed to strike the right balance between sophistication and mischief: polished enough to feel premium, but playful enough to feel alive.

name: Dig In
line: A food concept explored through branding and visual storytelling.
body: Dig In was a short lockdown project built around food, branding and visual storytelling.

Food has always been a big part of our world, and lockdown created the opportunity to explore that interest in a more focused way. The name Dig In had been sitting in the background for years, so the project became a chance to bring it to life with a brand and concept we genuinely cared about.
Centred around home-cooked food, photography, recipe ideas and content creation, the project gave us space to understand how food can be marketed differently to events, music and nightlife.

name: Moonshine
alt: Live singer and guests beside the Moonshine mural and sign.
line: Cocktails, live music and late nights in Leicester.
body: Moonshine brings cocktails, live music and late nights together in a Leicester speakeasy.
Our work brings the atmosphere of the venue into its content, campaigns and website.

name: Merchants Yard
alt: Warmly lit Winter Tipi at Merchants Yard at night.
line: A seasonal gathering place, brought to life through the Winter Tipi.
body: Merchants Yard is a seasonal gathering place in Leicester. The Winter Tipi brings warm evenings, music and shared tables to the city.
Our work covers venue content, campaigns, email marketing and the website, connecting the experience in the yard with the people coming through the doors.

name: Daal & Bass
alt: Manara performing in a supermarket for Daal & Bass Aisle by Aisle.
line: South Asian music culture, from the supermarket aisle to the dancefloor.
body: Daal & Bass connects South Asian music culture with the dancefloor. Its Aisle by Aisle series places DJs in the unexpected setting of a supermarket.
A Triple Down brand built around music, identity and shared cultural experience.
